insight.title: Your Body Is Constantly Glowing in the Dark
insight.subtitle: The invisible light your cells are emitting right now.
insight.notificationHook: Your body is constantly glowing in the dark

sections.text: Your body is constantly emitting light. Right now, you are literally glowing in the dark, but the light is just too faint for your own eyes to see.
This is living light. Chemical reactions inside your cells constantly leak tiny packets of light, which peak in the late afternoon when your body is working the hardest.
Ultra-sensitive cameras can easily capture this, mapping bright patches across your face. You are constantly walking around in a cloud of your own light.
Your body is making light you will never see.
